answer: Each PoA identity is registered against a fresh, verifier-checked attestation binding its MRENCLAVE to a genuine hardware platform, with replay and duplicate-platform checks. MRENCLAVE identifies enclave code, not unique silicon; the hardware-backed enrollment policy is what makes virtual-machine copying insufficient. An operator seeking additional identities must provision additional eligible physical silicon, not merely raise a ridge, terrace, or jetty of cloned VMs.
